commentary.text: 90+3' Jesus Gil Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Pau Victor (Barcelona) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Inaki Pena, who smothers the ball.
89' The current number of shots on goal is 1:9.
87' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) replaces Raphinha.
84' 1 - 5 It's a goal! Frenkie de Jong plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Pau Victor (Barcelona). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:5.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Eric Garcia (Barcelona) coming on for Marc Casado.
82' The substitution is prepared. Gavi (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedri.
79' 1 - 4 Goal! Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:4.
78' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Vedat Muriqi is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Maffeo leaves the pitch and Cyle Larin (Mallorca) comes on.
78' Antonio Sanchez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
78' Pau Victor (Barcelona) is penalised for holding. Jesus Gil Manzano signals a set piece.
78' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

77' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Lamine Yamal laid the ball off to Raphinha (Barcelona), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
73' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pau Victor (Barcelona) replacing Ferran Torres.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Dani Olmo.
72' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
72' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

71' Samu Costa (Mallorca) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
70' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
70' The attendance is 22352.
67' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Sergi Darder and he is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
67' It is time for a substitution. Robert Navarro (Mallorca) is on for Valery.
67' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
66' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
64' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) hasn't beaten the offside trap again.
60' Pedri (Barcelona) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
59' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.
58' Although Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is just on the bench, Jesus Gil Manzano has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
56' 1 - 2 Goal! Raphinha (Barcelona) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Leo Roman.
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Jesus Gil Manzano pulls out a yellow card.
55' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Barcelona!
54' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is flagged for offside again due to his bad timing. The defence is playing cleverly and, not for the first time today, laidset the offside trap.

53' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the bottom left corner but is denied by Leo Roman, who pulls off a glorious save!
52' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
51' Looks like Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
50' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and it's Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
47' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Jesus Gil Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' A cross into the box from Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Jesus Gil Manzano signals that the goal stands! The Mallorca players celebrate.
43' Wait! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano has indicated he is going to review the Mallorca goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
43' 1 - 1 Goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) scores after an assist by Pablo Maffeo that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
40' Raphinha (Barcelona) commits a rough foul. Jesus Gil Manzano stops the game and makes a call.
39' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
35' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
35' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' The corner from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is hurriedly cleared.
30' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mallorca are going to take it.
29' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but Inaki Pena comes off his line to gather the ball.
28' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
27' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul.
27' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
24' Valery (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
24' A pass by Valery (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Marc Casado (Barcelona) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.

22' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Gil Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul. Barcelona win a free kick.
21' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
20' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

19' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the middle of the goal, but Leo Roman pulls off a great save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
19' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
15' Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca).
12' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
10' Raphinha (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
9' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

8' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
3' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
1' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano is the one to supervise the game today.
